methodology.stream_handling: Use timestamps. Windows require every second present; cannot cross pauses or missing watts. Zero watts retained; null watts excluded. Reported time above threshold is count of non-null 1Hz records. Timestamp gaps are excluded from denominator, never filled with zero or counted as physiological recovery. Peak windows are observed ride windows, not maximal tests.
methodology.bursts: For either threshold (1.2 or 1.5 times current reference FTP), centered 5s moving average >=threshold, contiguous >=5s; bridge <=3 below-threshold seconds only in same uninterrupted 1Hz section; retain only bouts with raw-power mean>=threshold. Boundaries descriptive within about +/-2s, no lap assignment. Count and gap distribution depend on threshold. Main and last30 bout/peak stream indices are relative to that slice; elapsed seconds remain original activity coordinates.
methodology.main_portion_proxy: Exclude initial low-power lap (~29-30min recorded) and final low-power lap; this is file-lap proxy, not verified bunch/GPS boundary. Aug30 end retained because no clear final low-power lap. Oct8 Thursday separate context, not Crazies.
methodology.identity: Only Aug23 explicitly named Crazies. Similar Sunday rides are related Sunday samples based on user weekly-Crazies statement, not each independently established by title.

interpretation.supported: These recorded Sunday samples combine many 5-15s accelerations around/above 360W with fewer longer/harder >450W bouts, on top of 84-92min main ride proxies around 233-266W average. Absolute short power is useful; repeatability and retaining 30-60s power late also matter.
not_inferred: No assertion that current FTP=300W is physiological threshold; it is the current setting used for fixed reference bins.
No direct partition of aerobic/anaerobic energy, CP or W-prime depletion/reconstitution, or threshold training causal effects.
No inference that every high-power bout is an attack, every gap is easy recovery, or all named Sunday rides are independently confirmed Crazies.
No maximal-test classification for any power window.
No claim that Thursday group samples represent Sunday Crazies or all Singapore races.
